The issuer shows strong balance-sheet strength and liquidity, with current assets exceeding current liabilities (current ratio ~2.48) and relatively modest leverage (total liabilities ~38% of total assets). Earnings power is solid (EBIT margin ~15% and net margin ~11%) with a sizable equity base supporting retained earnings and profitability, pointing to a high investment-grade profile, though limited coverage/credit metrics constrain the very top end.

DECISION: A-
